[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] Headmaster [[Uthar Wynn]] constructed a '''[[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]]''' while he was an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] under [[Jorak Uln]].

In [[3956 BBY]], Wynn would use this [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] in the [[Naga Sadow's tomb|tomb]] of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] against his apprentice [[Yuthura Ban]] who had plotted with former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and amnesic [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] to eliminate him. Wynn used this weapon for the final time in an attempt to kill his usurpers, but perished. The lightsaber was presumably left with his corpse.
